aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.descripption1: Hello! I'm Victor Lopez. I'm 23 years old and I graduated with a degree in Networks and Computer Services from the University of Veracruz.
aboutMe.descripption2: My career began with a strong focus on systems administration, where I learned to understand technological infrastructure from its foundations. However, my curiosity for building solutions led me to software development. During my last year I have worked as a Full Stack developer, building applications with technologies like JavaScript and Node.js, and managing real deployments.
aboutMe.descripption3: Currently, I am self-studying Software Engineering to strengthen my architectural foundations. My big goal is to specialize as a DevOps engineer: I want to be the bridge that unites efficient code with robust, automated and scalable infrastructure. In addition, I am constantly learning, improving my technical English to open myself up to projects of global reach.
